mechanism: Estradiol may inhibit perphenazine metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing perphenazine levels and adverse effects; perphenazine may also increase estradiol levels through hepatic metabolism competition.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine side effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation); consider dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic if adverse effects occur; baseline and periodic assessment recommended.
